name: Quickened Rib
description: Drive a rib that regrows the instant it is spent into the target with a fast vital thrust.

name: Living Plate
description: Raise a plate of bone that grows back thicker each time a blow chips it.

name: Growth Feel
description: Feel the rate at which an ally's bones and wounds are mending and mark the slow ones.

name: Mending Marrow
description: Feed living qi into an ally's marrow to knit a deep break and refill the weakened bone.

name: Sprouting Spike
description: Sprout a spike of bone from the limb and let it keep growing through the target's guard.

name: Vital Brace
description: Brace the frame with living qi so it heals as it fights and bears each exchange better.

name: Thriving Frame
description: Hold a frame so full of life that blows are turned and small breaks close in the same breath.

name: Rampant Bone
description: Let bone grow wild in every direction from the user and pierce the foes close about.

name: Living Skeleton
description: Take a crushing blow into the frame and turn its force into new bone that mends the user.

name: Bone Bloom
description: streams: Bone + Life; let the frame blossom into a living thicket of blades that heals the user as it cuts.

name: Dry Knock
description: Strike with a knuckle bleached dry and brittle so the blow cracks what it lands on.

name: Bleached Guard
description: Dry the outer bone to a hard white shell that rattles but does not give.

name: Dust Rattle
description: Shake loose a rattle of dry bone dust in the target's face and spoil their aim.

name: Fading Sense
description: Feel how near a foe's bones stand to failing and which of them is weakest.

name: Withering Press
description: Lay a withering palm on the target and dry their bones until the limb refuses to rise.

name: Brittle Curse
description: Make the target's bones brittle so that every step and every blow they throw strains them.

name: Marrow Rot
description: Strike so a creeping decay enters the marrow and weakens the limb that was hit.

name: Skeletal Grip
description: Close a cold hand of white bone round the target's limb and hold it from moving.

name: Dead Weight
description: Add the weight of a dead frame to the target's own until they can hardly lift a limb.

name: Rattle Cascade
description: Send a rattling cascade of dry bones over every foe in front and crack them where they land.

name: Final Marrow
description: Drain the last life from a foe's marrow in a stroke that no guard of flesh can slow.

name: Ending Frame
description: streams: Bone + Death; let the frame itself become the end of the foe as their bones dry and fall.
